risks.data_migration: None: this slice adds NO migration and touches no model or schema. The alembic head is asserted UNCHANGED before and after.
risks.security_privacy: The offline posture is STRENGTHENED, not weakened: an AST-based regression test pins that no test constructs LiveFetcher (bar the sanctioned loopback-only fetcher unit test) and that scripts/capture_fixture.py is the only construction site outside fetch.py. The capture script is owner-run only, never invoked by tests or CI, and enforces the provider official-domain allowlist through the existing FetchPolicy. NO DNS-rebinding hardening is attempted here (deferred, Q7-A). No secrets in any fixture; detect-secrets re-run after git add.
risks.portability: No new runtime or test dependency (Q6-A): stdlib + the already-installed toolchain only. No Redis; PostgreSQL stays the only mandatory stateful service. amd64/arm64 unaffected.
risks.zero_cost_safety: Untouched: this slice supplies DATA and a HARNESS, not new classification machinery. The Z0 rules, the publication gate and 'unknown is better than guessed' are asserted (the unresolvable-fixture path refuses to guess a MIME) rather than relaxed. Community-vs-official separation is unchanged.
risks.immutability: offer_version remains immutable/append-only: nothing here writes offer/offer_version. The Cloudflare refactor is behaviour-neutral and the content_hash is asserted identical, so no spurious version is minted.
risks.regression: The Cloudflare profile move is the main regression surface; it is mitigated by keeping the existing Cloudflare tests UNCHANGED and asserting an identical content_hash. The reconcile idempotency guard is additive and only suppresses a DUPLICATE event for an already-evented candidate; its regression test is written to go RED if the guard is removed.
risks.supply_chain: No new npm or Python dependency; pip-audit + npm audit + detect-secrets stay green. Any package install would go through the Microsoft feed proxies (pip https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple; NuGet https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/nuget/v3/index.json) - none is needed.
risks.concurrency: S1 is building concurrently and HAS RIGHT OF WAY. Footprints are disjoint by construction; on any conflict this slice rebases onto S1. Live-run isolation uses POSTGRES_PORT=55434 API_PORT=8012 WEB_PORT=8092 and compose project -p ftatlas_f008_s3 so it cannot collide with S1's 55432/8010/8090.
